title: feat(plugin-security): organization administrators hold manage_connector_connections by default (ADR-0143 D5, ruling B)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao6NziWpbTDqMqVqQDfDXvBa)_

Part of #28427. This PR carries the code, pins, docs and changeset. The card's item 4 (one line in ADR-0143 D5 recording ruling B) is split out so that this PR is not held as Tier H; the line is handed to the seat as a patch, and the card stays open until it lands.

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：组织管理员（`organization_admin`，以及由它派生的 `organization_admin_no_bypass`）默认拥有 `manage_connector_connections`，组织的 owner/admin 一开始就能为本组织连接 OAuth2 连接器（DocuSign、Salesforce、Google 等），不再需要有人手工绑定权限集。
- 为什么改：Tesla 在决策清单第 6 项答「同意」，即选 B：「B：开一张跟进卡，在 S4 Console Connect 之前默认授予 organization_admin 与 organization_admin_no_bypass」（裁决记录 #28327 评论 6545223261）。不改的话，S4 的 Connect 按钮上线后每个组织管理员都会被拒。
- 风险与回滚：这是一次放宽：组织管理员现在能读、发起、完成、撤销本组织的连接；只限本组织（授予按组织生效，门只作用于当前组织），看不到任何令牌。成员、只读等其它权限集不变，其它能力也不变。代表组织管理员、带 `actions:execute` 授权的 AI agent 会一起获得（沿用现有派生，平台管理员的 agent 今天已是如此），见 Acceptance notes。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/objects/default-permission-sets.ts` 的 `organization_admin.systemPermissions` 一行；`objects/default-permission-sets.test.ts` 的两条持有者 pin；`automation-connector-connection-door.test.ts` 的"本组织放行、他组织拒绝"用例。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-security exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/objects/default-permission-sets.test.ts`，预期全绿，持有者恰为 `admin_full_access`、`organization_admin`、`organization_admin_no_bypass` 三个。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

**The grant.** `organization_admin`'s `systemPermissions` gains `manage_connector_connections` (`default-permission-sets.ts`). The set is declared once; `deriveWallLessOrgAdmin` spreads the parent's declaration and drops only the wildcard superuser bits, so `organization_admin_no_bypass` carries the capability from that one line. It is never written a second time. `auto-org-admin-grant.ts` already grants one of the two sets, per organization and by posture, to every member whose role contains `owner` or `admin`, so those members hold the capability in that organization.

**Scope.** The capability is `org`-scoped. Core's resolver applies an organization-scoped grant only in the organization the grant row names (`grantAppliesInTenant` in `resolve-authz-context.ts`), and the connection door hands the service the caller's own `tenantId`. So an organization admin of `org_a` connects `org_a`'s instances only. In an organization where they are a plain member they hold the member baseline, which does not carry the capability, and the door refuses them.

**Unchanged.** `member_default`, `viewer_readonly` and every other shipped set hold the capability only by explicit grant. No other capability of any set moves. Nothing under `packages/spec` changes.

**The agent golden.** `builtin-positions.boot.test.ts` and `grant-permission-set-name.equivalence.test.ts` build the agent row from the organization admin's resolved envelope through `assembleExecutionContext` (`packages/core/src/security/assemble-execution-context.ts`). For an OAuth agent with `actions:execute` (`delegatesActions`), that function passes the human's `systemPermissions` through unchanged. The agent's golden gains the capability through that path only. No line names an agent.

**Docs.** `content/docs/automation/connectors.mdx`: the connect paragraph now says platform administrators and organization administrators hold the capability by default, and anyone else receives it through a permission set.

## Tests

- `objects/default-permission-sets.test.ts`: the holders of `manage_connector_connections` across the shipped sets are exactly `admin_full_access`, `organization_admin`, `organization_admin_no_bypass`. `member_default` and `viewer_readonly` exist and do not hold it. A second pin asserts the no-bypass variant's `systemPermissions` equal its parent's, so the capability rides the derivation and is not a second list.
- `automation-connector-connection-door.test.ts` (runtime), for each of GET / POST / DELETE / callback: an organization admin on the shipped grant is admitted with 200, and the service member is called once with `tenantId: 'org_a'`. The same person active in `org_b`, holding the member baseline there, is refused with 403 `PERMISSION_DENIED`, the message names the capability, and no service member runs. The transcribed `ORG_ADMIN_GRANT` now carries the capability.
- Grant goldens: `resolve-authz-grant-set-by-name.golden.test.ts`, `grant-readers-by-name.golden.test.ts`, `grant-permission-set-name.equivalence.test.ts` and `builtin-positions.boot.test.ts`. Each gains the capability on the organization admin's envelope inside the organization, and on the agent acting for them. The resolver golden's `noOrganization` envelope stays `systemPermissions: []`.
- `packages-capability-gate.test.ts`: the commit-trail refusal case named "the organization admin's full grant" now lists the full grant. It is still refused, because that door asks `studio.access`.

Whole packages on `29c35857`: plugin-security `Test Files 238 passed (238)`, `Tests 5126 passed | 45 skipped (5171)`. runtime `Test Files 496 passed (496)`, `Tests 8972 passed | 19 skipped (8991)`.

<details><summary>Ablations</summary>

Both mutations went through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`. The anchor landed on disk (count 1 → 0), and the file was restored with the blob equal to HEAD and `git diff HEAD` empty. Both suites import their subjects from `src`, so no dist was involved.

| mutation | run | red |
|:--|:--|:--|
| drop `'manage_connector_connections'` from `organization_admin.systemPermissions` (`default-permission-sets.ts`) | the five plugin-security files above | 17 / 93: the holders pin, all 8 boot cases, 2 equivalence, 3 grant-readers, 3 resolver goldens |
| the connection gate never refuses (`refuseUngrantedConnectorConnectionAccess` call replaced by `undefined`, `automation.ts`) | `automation-connector-connection-door.test.ts -t 'refused in another'` | 4 / 4: `expected 200 to be 403` on each verb |

The derivation-equality pin stays green under the first mutation, as expected, since both variants lose the capability together. The holders pin is the one that reds there.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **ADR-0143 D5 line, split out.** CODEOWNERS makes `docs/adr/**` Tier H. The line is a record of ruling B and changes no code path, so it ships separately rather than holding this PR. Patch for the seat: `server-seat-1/r2026-10-31/out/28427-adr-0143-d5.patch`. The landing of that PR closes the card.
- **Three `packages/spec` comments ruling B makes false, left untouched by the seat's ruling (spec lane's line, handed over after this merges):** `packages/spec/src/security/capabilities.ts:103-110`, `packages/spec/src/identity/eval-user.zod.ts:166-169`, `packages/spec/src/identity/platform-admin-capabilities.test.ts:52-54`. Each says the organization administrator holds the capability only by explicit grant.
- **Agents acting for an organization admin reach the door.** The connection door reads only `systemPermissions`, and an OAuth agent with `actions:execute` carries its human's list. So an agent acting for an organization admin can now read, begin and revoke that organization's connection, as an agent acting for a platform admin already can on `main`. Ruling B did not address agents. Whether the door should refuse an agent principal is a separate question for the seat.
- `content/docs/permissions/permission-sets.mdx`'s summary row for `organization_admin` names a subset of its capabilities (it already leaves out `manage_mailboxes`), so it is not edited here.
- Branch `claude/project-thread-jtzyzv` is the card thread's platform-assigned branch; claim 6545275282 names it.

## Verification

Local, on `29c35857`: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 92 families. Each was run with stdin from `/dev/null`, and its exit was captured by redirect before any pipe. All 92 exit 0. Three of them (`check:skill-examples`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:i18n`) first exited 3, PREREQUISITE NOT MET, and were re-run after a full `pnpm build`. `--ran`: `92 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 92 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED`, exit 0. Scoped lint, the root `lint` script's eslint over `packages/plugins/plugin-security packages/runtime` with `--no-inline-config`: exit 0. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-security --filter @objectstack/runtime run typecheck`: exit 0.
